summary: Completed AI-Augmented Engineering pretest and toolchain verification: Python 3.13.5, Git 2.52.0, Node 22.17.1, Windows 11 with PowerShell in agent mode.
evidence: Verified local environment: Python 3.13.5, Git 2.52.0, Node 22.17.1 on Windows 11 using PowerShell in autonomous agent mode.
Self-rating: strong (experienced decomposing work for AI, critically reviewing code, and iterating efficiently).
API credentials response: extract connection string to .env and implement strict Pydantic request schema validation.
Trust boundary definition: never use AI when lacking domain knowledge to independently verify correctness, security, and edge-case behavior.
Unclear function protocol: ask AI for rationale, verify against official documentation and unit tests before approval.
Code review methodology: chunked review prioritizing architecture and interfaces, data flow, security boundaries, and test coverage.
Context upfront rationale: upfront architectural constraints prevent hallucinated assumptions that compound into regressions.
Multiple solutions criteria: select the cleanest, most maintainable, and verifiable design matching system requirements.
Production risk assessment: subtle security vulnerabilities and silent failure modes that pass casual code review.
